verdict.rationale: Daytona is positioned for running AI-generated code (probe-1) and documents the core safeguards. Each sandbox is isolated with a dedicated kernel, filesystem, network stack and allocated resources (docs-28), with an optional dedicated-VM mode (docs-15). A per-sandbox firewall blocks untrusted code from exfiltrating data or contacting arbitrary hosts, and it can be configured at creation or while running (docs-26, docs-19, docs-8). Code runs inside these sandboxes through stateless or stateful execution APIs (docs-25, docs-6, docs-33). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the isolation actually contains hostile code, such as security audits or escape testing.
